Contact PakToolkit

Get in touch

For suggestions, corrections (especially if a rate or slab looks out of date), or a new tool you wish existed, write to us at sufyanbarret@gmail.com. We read every message.

What to include

Tell us which tool you used, what you entered, and what you expected. For calculator corrections, a link to the official source (NEPRA, FBR, your DISCO or a board/university notice) helps us fix things fastest.

Response time

PakToolkit is run by a small team, so replies can take a few days. Urgent calculator errors reported with an official source are fixed on priority.

Email: sufyanbarret@gmail.com
